key_points: iPhone Duo foldable launch shows strong initial demand, prompting Apple to secure additional supplies.
Apple stock reaches record highs and overtakes Nvidia in market cap amid the product debut.
Optimistic analyst commentary (e.g., Gene Munster) projects significant revenue contribution and higher unit sales than Wall Street estimates.
While some AI supply chain headwinds were noted recently, the immediate product momentum and market cap milestone support a positive near-term outlook.
Institutional buying/selling headlines are routine portfolio rebalancing and represent low-impact noise.
